forum.title: Missing stm32wbaxx_hal_pka.c file
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@dc2ac

Could you please try to click at "Open Projects from File System" to open the example

![KDJEM1_1-1764666714096.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/0e851812-db88-8b92-020e-3c43265b22fb.png)

Then, choose the "Directory"

![KDJEM1_0-1764666666857.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/c3223b16-0f5e-4660-8324-9edc9203b475.png)

If you want to generate code from .ioc file using STM32CubeMX toolchain, I recommend you to copy the .ioc file in a new workspace then generate code and open the project using STM32CubeIDE.

This is a know issue for CubeMX:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/0e3a3bc0-9292-4b0d-805b-c1bdd2a9f07d.png)

Ps: the same issue has been answered [here](https://community.st.com/stm32-mcus-wireless-35/unable-to-build-example-project-on-nucleo-stm32wba55-159867).

Best Regards.

II
forum.content_text:
After generating the BLE\_Sensor project files for the B-WBA5M-WPAN board with STM32CubeMX Version 6.17.0, the STM32CubeIDE shown this error. I looked for the file in STM32Cube\_FW\_WBA\_V1.9.0 and it is not there. Please advise.

10:56:39 \*\*\*\* Incremental Build of configuration Debug for project BLE\_Sensor \*\*\*\*

make -j9 all

make: \*\*\* No rule to make target '/Users/user/STM32Cube/Example/BLE\_Sensor/Drivers/STM32WBAxx\_HAL\_Driver/Src/stm32wbaxx\_hal\_pka.c', needed by 'Drivers/STM32WBAxx\_HAL\_Driver/stm32wbaxx\_hal\_pka.o'. Stop.

"make -j9 all" terminated with exit code 2. Build might be incomplete.
